_what: The index's best-measured-today figure. One line per model per machine, each the fastest configuration that model has been measured in; five of the Radeon lines share one campaign and two do not, and the A100 side is the whole 2026-08-29 campaign rather than one model of it. Speculation is a switch on each model that has an arm, named for the method the engine resolved. Derived by site/src/genfig-index.py from benchmarks/ledger.jsonl, benchmarks/speculative-decoding/ and benchmarks/cuda-a100/.
